user.title: Add habit
user.description: Each habit is tracked per day and shown in the weekly Habit Tracker card.

data_description.target: For count habits: the number that counts as done for the day (e.g. 20 pushups). Ignored for done / not done.
data_description.days: Days you plan the habit for. Other days can still be ticked in the card, they are just dimmed.
data_description.per_week: Optional. How many done days a week is the goal, e.g. 3. Empty = every planned day.
